title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade node toolchain and improve caching
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: We have accumulated multiple overlapping GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing, and release automation across the monorepo. This caused long CI times, inconsistent caching, and duplication of YAML. This PR consolidates workflows into a smaller, well-documented set, upgrades Node to 20 in the build/test matrix, improves cache keys for faster incremental runs, and standardizes release automation. Changes include: consolidated workflows: ci/lint-and-test.yml (runs lint + unit/integration tests with matrix), ci/release.yml (centralized release & changelog generation), ci/checks.yml (quick pre-merge checks), and removed several repo-specific ad-hoc workflows; Node toolchain: default matrix Node version bumped to 18,20 (deprecates 16), with Node 20 as primary build for release; caching: unified npm/yarn cache keys based on repo checksum + lockfile hash, improved action caching for Docker build layers in containerized packages; release automation: adopt single canonical release action, standardized changelog generation (conventional commits), and artifact signing step; repo hygiene: remove legacy scripts, update CONTRIBUTING.md with CI expectations, and add CI badge to README. Checklist: [x] Consolidate workflows + remove duplicates. [x] Upgrade Node versions in matrix and Dockerfiles. [x] Improve cache keys and add Docker layer caching. [x] Update docs and CONTRIBUTING. [x] Run full CI across redwood and SDK repos. Testing: CI matrix ran on an ephemeral branch with all integration suites passing. Manual smoke tests performed for release flow in staging. Rollout: merge to main triggers the new workflows; legacy workflow files are removed; rollout monitored via actions history for 48 hours with ability to revert via rollback branch if needed. Known limitations: a few legacy Dockerfiles in examples/ still reference node:16 — follow-up PR to update example artifacts. Related: ENG-1824 (CI consolidation), ENG-2033 (build cache improvements).
commits: chore(ci): introduce unified release.yml with changelog generation
fix(ci): improve npm/yarn cache keys and Docker layer caching
chore(repo): remove legacy ad-hoc workflows and update CONTRIBUTING.md
chore(docker): bump node base images to 18/20 where applicable

release_notes:
- Consolidated CI workflows: lint/test/release/checks
- Upgraded Node toolchain to include Node 20 as primary build target (Node 16 deprecated)
- Improved caching for npm/yarn and Docker layers
- Standardized release automation and changelog generation
notes_for_maintainers: After merge, monitor Actions runs for 48 hours. If there are flaky jobs tied to OS/matrix combos revert by creating a hotfix branch and re-adding the legacy workflow temporarily. Follow-up: update example Dockerfiles that still use node:16 (tracked ENG-2101).
backout_instructions: Create branch revert/ci-consolidation and reintroduce legacy workflows from commit <removed-workflows> if a hot rollback is required. Notify infra@redwood and tag ENG-1824.
